legacyReply: **Done.** Lens 1 now shows the machine-learning formula $H(p,q)=-\sum_x p(x)\log_2 q(x)$, reads it aloud, and starts from a forecaster who wrongly believes the weather is uniform (2 bits instead of 1.75, so she pays 0.25 extra). **Rung 3** has the derivation $H(p,q)=H(p)+D(p\|q)$ as an exercise, with a hint and a folded solution.
